instruction: I want you to play the Rick Astley music video on my desktop with the vlc media player.

files.path: /home/user/Desktop/Rick Astley - Never Gonna Give You Up (Official Music Video).mp4

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

rules.file_name: Rick Astley - Never Gonna Give You Up (Official Music Video).mp4

metadata.explanation: First-person request variation. Evaluator checks that VLC has successfully started playing the Rick Astley music video file from the desktop.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies both requirements: VLC is in 'playing' state AND the correct file is loaded
Getter (get_vlc_playing_info) appropriately fetches VLC status via HTTP API and saves XML to cache
Metric (is_vlc_playing) correctly parses XML, checks state='playing', then verifies filename match
Expected file_name matches the actual downloaded file from config (Rick Astley - Never Gonna Give You Up (Official Music Video).mp4)
Parameter handling is correct: metric receives rule dict directly from get_rule, accesses rule['type'] and rule['file_name']
Multiple fallback XML paths provide robustness for finding file info in different VLC XML structures
Edge cases handled: returns 0 if not playing, if file info missing, or if filename mismatch
No postconfig needed as VLC HTTP status API remains accessible after playback starts
